summary: Bushland kerb on Crag Road where cars park; houses 18-27 m opposite.
reasons: Bush on the van's own side

best_section.where: North kerb of Crag Road where cars park against the bush, opposite the houses at the 112 m mark

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the north side; the nearest homes are 18-27 m away across the road, so close enough to notice a van.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road; a few cars parked along the north edge; ground beside the lane looks narrow with bush behind.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street leading to a bush dead end; little through traffic expected.
drivers.convention: No signs; other cars park along this kerb, but not a clear overnight convention.

flags: Steep: about 4% at the best section, 5.6% mean, max 12.2% elsewhere
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the kerb, mostly from the north and east; open to afternoon sun from the west along the road.
cannot_judge: Width of verge beside the lane
